actions.mechanism: Separate presence from condition so counting never implies inspection, and previous good condition cannot silently carry forward.
actions.implementation: Use a paper sheet listing ten IDs, presence, condition category or unknown, inspector initials, and time. Start each transaction with condition unknown.
actions.check: Record a counted-only return: all ten IDs show present, all conditions remain unknown, and no verified-good summary appears.
actions.risk: Pre-filled condition values could conceal skipped inspections.

actions.mechanism: Keep inspection authorship unchanged while transferring responsibility for unfinished work to a named receiving staff member.
actions.implementation: Attach the evidence sheet to the kit record. Outgoing staff list unresolved IDs; incoming staff initial acceptance and the next review time.
actions.check: After a shift change, ask incoming staff to identify outstanding checks, their owner, and who recorded each existing inspection.
actions.risk: An unsigned transfer needs a named duty-lead fallback.

actions.action: Turn missing components into assigned recovery tasks
actions.mechanism: A missing ID creates an owned task rather than disappearing inside a general incomplete status.
actions.implementation: For each missing ID, record an owner, next action, and due time; begin with a storage-area search, then borrower contact if unresolved.
actions.check: Simulate one missing component. Verify its task survives shift transfer and closes only after recovery evidence or an authorized disposition.
actions.risk: Duplicate tasks may arise unless linked to the transaction.

actions.action: Timebox handoffs without converting uncertainty into approval
actions.mechanism: Separate custody transfer from readiness to lend; unfinished inspection can remain pending without extending the handoff.
actions.implementation: Use a shared clock: stop inspection at two minutes, reserve one minute for ownership transfer, and keep unresolved kits off the lending shelf.
actions.check: Time a counted-only return through transfer: finish within three minutes, preserve unknown conditions, and assign remaining inspection before release.
actions.risk: Pending kits need scheduled review to avoid indefinite delays.
